strings.zh: 我是关东地区的钓鱼名人,{NEWLINE}为了钓鱼方便{CLEAR}专门在海边建了这座房子。{SCROLL}你……{NEWLINE}看样子{CLEAR}应该很喜欢钓鱼吧？{SCROLL}怎么样！说中了？{NEWLINE}我看人的眼光{CLEAR}可是有名的！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I’m Kanto’s famous Fishing Guru. I built{NEWLINE}this house by the sea just to make{CLEAR}fishing easier.{SCROLL}You... Looks like you really love{NEWLINE}fishing, don’t you?{SCROLL}Well? Did I get it right? My eye for{NEWLINE}people is famous!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 嗯,嗯！不出所料！{NEWLINE}一看你就是个钓鱼的老手了。{SCROLL}不过钓鱼可是一门很深的学问,{NEWLINE}你还有很大的进步空间,{CLEAR}如果你能打败{CLEAR}寂静之桥上的钓鱼爱好者们,{CLEAR}我就把钓鱼的终极之道教给你。
strings.en: Yes, yes! Just as I thought!{SCROLL}One look and I could tell you’re a{NEWLINE}seasoned angler.{SCROLL}But fishing is a deep art, and you’ve{NEWLINE}still got plenty of room to grow. If you{CLEAR}can beat the fishing fans on Silence{CLEAR}Bridge, I’ll teach you the ultimate way{CLEAR}of fishing.

strings.zh: 到各地去享受钓鱼的乐趣吧！{SCROLL}不同的钓竿钓到的精灵也会不同哦！
strings.en: Try your hand at fishing wherever there{NEWLINE}is water.{SCROLL}Remember--you can catch different{NEWLINE}Pokémon depending on which Rod you use.

strings.notes: US 0349/3 | RV013: meaning: 我看走眼了 is a statement (misjudged), not a question

strings.zh: 能看到你这样的年轻训练家{NEWLINE}热爱钓鱼我是很高兴啦,{CLEAR}但是你现在好像还没有好钓竿嘛。{SCROLL}去枯叶市的钓鱼达人那里看看怎么样,{NEWLINE}那里应该有{CLEAR}适合你这个级别钓手的好钓竿哟。
strings.en: I’m glad to see a young Trainer like you{NEWLINE}who loves fishing, but it looks like you{CLEAR}don’t have a good rod yet.{SCROLL}Why not visit the Fishing Guru in{NEWLINE}Vermilion City? He should have a good{CLEAR}rod for an angler at your level.

strings.zh: 哦哦？已经打败了那几位{NEWLINE}优秀的钓鱼爱好者了？{CLEAR}不错不错,你很有天赋。{CLEAR}那么你配得上我这把高级钓竿。
strings.en: Oh ho? You’ve already beaten those fine{NEWLINE}anglers?{SCROLL}Not bad, not bad. You’ve got talent.{NEWLINE}Then you’re worthy of my Super Rod.

strings.zh: 有了这把钓竿,{NEWLINE}在整个地区的各个水域,{CLEAR}就没有你钓不上来的鱼啦。{SCROLL}所以说装备才是钓鱼的终极之道。
strings.en: With this rod, there’s no fish in any{NEWLINE}waters of the whole region that you{CLEAR}can’t reel in.{SCROLL}So you see, gear is the ultimate way of{NEWLINE}fishing.

strings.zh: 我在这里跟师傅学习钓鱼,{NEWLINE}不过总是钓上一些贝类却钓不到鱼。
strings.en: I’m learning to fish from my master{NEWLINE}here, but I always reel in shellfish{CLEAR}instead of fish.

strings.zh: 师傅既然把高级钓竿交给了你,{NEWLINE}说明你也是个厉害的钓鱼专家吧？{CLEAR}那你手里一定有很多{CLEAR}抓捕水系精灵专用的撒网球咯？{SCROLL}我用我钓上来的贝类里面的大珍珠{NEWLINE}换你的撒网球怎么样？{CLEAR}5个撒网球换一颗大珍珠。{SCROLL}
strings.en: My master gave you the Super Rod, so{NEWLINE}you must be quite the fishing expert{CLEAR}too, right? Then you must have lots of{CLEAR}Net Balls, the kind made for catching{CLEAR}Water types!{SCROLL}How about I trade you the Big Pearls{NEWLINE}from the shellfish I’ve caught for your{CLEAR}Net Balls?{SCROLL}Five Net Balls for one Big Pearl.{SCROLL}
You don’t have enough Net Balls.

strings.zh: 谢谢你跟我交换,{NEWLINE}这是大珍珠,请拿好。
strings.en: Thanks for trading with me. Here are{NEWLINE}your Big Pearls.
